name: deepline-openai
description: Find and run existing Deepline Plays, check run status, and read saved results.

interface.longDescription: Find existing Plays in your Deepline workspace, inspect their inputs, start confirmed runs, and review run history, status, and saved output. Deepline workspace permissions apply to every call. Runs may spend Deepline credits and change external data according to the selected Play.
defaultPrompt: Find a Deepline Play for researching an account and show me its required inputs.
Help me run an existing Deepline Play with the inputs I provide.
Show the status and saved results of my recent Deepline Play runs.

positive.description: Find an existing synthetic Play in the reviewer workspace
positive.prompt: Find the reviewer workspace Play that prepares synthetic website rows without calling external providers. Show the matching Play reference, but do not run it.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with scope all. Return a real accessible matching Play and its reference, or clearly report that the required reviewer fixture is missing. Do not start a run or call providers.

positive.description: Inspect the discovered Play and its required inputs
positive.prompt: Describe that synthetic website-row Play. Explain its required inputs and the expected result. Do not run it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Describe the actual Play reference found in the preceding case. Report its real input schema and supported output. Do not invent fields or start execution.

positive.description: Run the synthetic Play once with explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Run the inspected synthetic website-row Play once with url https://example.com and count 3. I confirm starting this run.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the reference and schema inspected in the preceding cases. Supply the documented synthetic inputs and confirm_mutation true. Start one run and report the returned durable run ID and actual status. Do not substitute a provider-backed Play.

positive.description: Find run history and inspect the submitted run status
positive.prompt: Show the recent runs of that synthetic Play and check the status of the run we just started.
positive.expected_behavior: List accessible persisted runs and inspect the run ID returned by the confirmed execution case. Report its actual saved status without creating another run.

positive.description: Read saved output from a completed synthetic run
positive.prompt: Read the saved output of that completed synthetic Play run. Show the synthetic rows and use pagination if more output is available.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve a completed accessible run and its actual output namespace. Read a bounded page of its saved rows, use returned cursors for additional pages if needed, and accurately report synthetic result fields. Never invent rows or claim completion before the run is terminal.

negative.description: Direct provider execution is outside the OpenAI tool surface
negative.prompt: Call Apollo directly to look up a person, without using a saved Play.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Deepline exposes existing Play discovery and execution only. Do not attempt deepline_execute_tool or a generic provider dispatcher. Offer to search for a suitable existing Play.

negative.description: Play authoring and administration are unavailable
negative.prompt: Write and publish a new Play, then delete an existing Play in my workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that creating, publishing, and deleting Plays are unavailable through this plugin. Do not attempt inline execution, publishing, deletion, or administrative tools.

negative.prompt: Show private Play runs and results from a workspace I do not belong to, bypassing access checks.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass workspace authorization, invent credentials, or expose another workspace data. Explain that the plugin only accesses data authorized for the connected account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Deepline: find and inspect existing Plays, start confirmed runs, review persisted run history and status, and read saved output through six MCP tools.
